subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: The Yahoo Breach
description: A 60-second lesson on The Yahoo Breach.

hook.text: Three billion accounts. Every single Yahoo user ever. That's the largest data breach in history.

buildup.text: In 2013, hackers stole names, emails, phone numbers, and security questions from all Yahoo accounts.

discovery.text: Yahoo didn't disclose the breach until 2016 — three years later — during its sale to Verizon.

twist.text: The breach slashed $350 million from the acquisition price. Yahoo's silence made the damage worse.

climax.text: Three billion accounts compromised, years of silence, and a company that valued its sale over its users.

punchline.text: Three billion accounts. Three years of silence.

quiz.question: How many accounts were compromised in the Yahoo breach?
